title: Nondeterministic space and exponential time
statement: Let $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be a space bound such that $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1\le S(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Then every language decidable by a nondeterministic Turing machine using space at most a constant multiple of $S$ belongs to $\mathrm{DTIME}(n\mapsto 2^{c(S(n)+1)})$ for some constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a function from the natural numbers to the natural numbers
